_readme: Meridian execution config. Default is signals-only: signals are displayed, nothing is submitted.
The credential comes from process.env.OANDA. It is never read from this file.
Every setting is labelled with where its value came from: OWNER (the owner supplied it in
ownerSettings), DEMO TEST (the values the owner directed for a Practice-only demo run), or
TEST (a labelled test value). A setting with none of those is UNSET and nothing trades.
DEMO TEST is the profile active below: 0.1% risk per trade, at most 1 open Meridian trade,
0.5% daily loss threshold, 3-pip spread cap, 300-second signal expiry, and every other one of
the twelve required settings stated explicitly in lib/config.ts (DEMO_TEST_PROFILE). It is NOT
the owner's real risk settings and must never be presented as their appetite for risk; it is
labelled DEMO TEST in the execution record and on the console. Exactly one labelled profile
may be active, so useTestProfile stays false: flipping it on would apply the older TEST values
instead, or refuse outright.
Mode is approve-before-execution: an instruction is previewed with its exact order, price and
account state are re-read immediately before submission, and it is submitted only on the
owner's explicit approval of that payload hash. The watcher never submits in this mode. The
owner approves the first Practice order.
submissionPolicy.maxAttempts is 1: one submission attempt per approved payload. An uncertain
outcome (timeout, lost connection) is never retried — it is recorded and the signal stays
blocked until the broker's own state has been read. The order path performs exactly one POST,
so a configured value above 1 cannot raise it; status.json reports both numbers.
meridian-h1-v1 is enabled so the invented ruleset is armed to originate Practice orders for the
demo test under approval — every order it originates is labelled INVENTED_RULESET_TEST, and it
is measured not tradeable at both hourly and daily granularity. owner-method stays disabled:
the owner has supplied no rule. automatic stays unreachable (automaticAcknowledged false).
The profile cannot change the trading host: the host is a frozen constant in lib/interlock.ts
and the order path asserts it on every request.
